items.title: Change color age - mark
items.description: Mark red spiders for AGE-safe to_gh rewrite

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node)
WHERE n.t = 2
SET n._to_gh_mark = true
RETURN count(n) AS marked

items.title: Change color age - recolor
items.description: Recolor marked red spiders to green

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})
SET n.t = 1
RETURN count(n) AS recolored

items.title: Change color age - toggle wires
items.description: Toggle edge types around marked spiders (1 <-> 2)

code.value:
MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})-[w:Wire]-()
WHERE w.t IN [1, 2]
WITH DISTINCT w
SET w.t = CASE w.t WHEN 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
RETURN count(w) AS toggled

MATCH (n:Node {_to_gh_mark: true})
REMOVE n._to_gh_mark
RETURN count(n) AS cleaned

MATCH (a:Node)-[:Wire {t: 1}]->(b:Node)
WHERE a.t IN [1, 2]
  AND b.t IN [1, 2]
  AND a.t = b.t
WITH CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN a ELSE b END AS u,
     CASE WHEN id(a) < id(b) THEN b ELSE a END AS v
LIMIT 1
CREATE (merged:Node {
  phase: coalesce(u.phase, 0) + coalesce(v.phase, 0),
  t: u.t,
  graph_id: coalesce(u.graph_id, v.graph_id),
  id: coalesce(u.id, v.id),
  qubit: coalesce(u.qubit, v.qubit),
  row: coalesce(u.row, v.row),
  _new_merged_node: true
})
WITH u, v, merged
OPTIONAL MATCH (u)-[ru:Wire]-(nu:Node)
WHERE nu <> v
CREATE (merged)-[:Wire {
  t: coalesce(ru.t, 1),
  graph_id: coalesce(ru.graph_id, merged.graph_id, nu.graph_id)
}]->(nu)
WITH DISTINCT u, v, merged
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)-[rv:Wire]-(nv:Node)
WHERE nv <> u
CREATE (merged)-[:Wire {
  t: coalesce(rv.t, 1),
  graph_id: coalesce(rv.graph_id, merged.graph_id, nv.graph_id)
}]->(nv)
WITH DISTINCT u, v
DETACH DELETE u, v
RETURN 1 AS rewrites_applied

items.title: Spider fusion age reverse
items.description: AGE-compatible spider fusion (reverse directed match) without reduce/foreach

code.value:
MATCH (a:Node)<-[:Wire {t: 1}]-(b:Node)
WHERE a.t IN [1, 2]
  AND b.t IN [1, 2]
  AND a.t = b.t

LIMIT 1

items.title: Spider fusion age - normalize
items.description: Normalize parallel edges after merge and apply phase updates

code.value:
MATCH (m:Node {_new_merged_node: true})-[w:Wire]-(n:Node)
WHERE coalesce(m.graph_id, '__GRAPH_ID__') = '__GRAPH_ID__'
  AND coalesce(n.graph_id, '__GRAPH_ID__') = '__GRAPH_ID__'
  AND id(n) <> id(m)
WITH m, n, collect(DISTINCT w) AS ws
WHERE size(ws) > 1
UNWIND ws AS rel
WITH m, n, ws,
     sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(rel.t, 1) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_simple,
     sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(rel.t, 1) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c_hadamard
UNWIND ws AS del
DELETE del
WITH m, n, c_simple, c_hadamard,
     CASE WHEN coalesce(m.t, -1) = coalesce(n.t, -1) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS fuse_type
WITH m, n,
     CASE
         WHEN fuse_type = 1 THEN CASE WHEN c_simple > 0 THEN c_hadamard ELSE 0 END
         ELSE CASE WHEN c_hadamard > 0 AND c_simple % 2 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     END AS phase_add,
     CASE
         WHEN fuse_type = 1 THEN CASE
             WHEN c_simple > 0 THEN 1
             WHEN c_hadamard % 2 = 1 THEN 2
             ELSE 0
         END
         ELSE CASE
             WHEN c_hadamard > 0 THEN 2
             WHEN c_simple % 2 = 1 THEN 1
             ELSE 0
         END
     END AS out_type
WITH m, n, phase_add, out_type,
     id(m) AS mid,
     id(n) AS nid
SET m.phase = coalesce(m.phase, 0) + CASE WHEN mid <= nid THEN phase_add ELSE 0 END,
    n.phase = coalesce(n.phase, 0) + CASE WHEN mid > nid THEN phase_add ELSE 0 END
WITH m, n, out_type
WHERE out_type <> 0
CREATE (m)-[:Wire {t: out_type, graph_id: coalesce(m.graph_id, n.graph_id)}]->(n)
RETURN count(*) AS normalized

items.title: Spider fusion age - self loops
items.description: Remove self-loops and add pi phase for odd hadamard loops

code.value:
MATCH (v:Node)-[r:Wire]-(v)
WHERE v.t IN [1, 2] AND coalesce(v.graph_id, '__GRAPH_ID__') = '__GRAPH_ID__'
WITH v, collect(r) AS self_loops
WHERE size(self_loops) > 0
WITH v, self_loops
UNWIND self_loops AS sr
WITH v, self_loops,
     sum(CASE WHEN coalesce(sr.t, 1) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hadamard_count
SET v.phase = coalesce(v.phase, 0) + CASE WHEN hadamard_count % 2 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
WITH self_loops
UNWIND self_loops AS loop_edge
DELETE loop_edge
RETURN count(loop_edge) AS loops_deleted

items.title: Spider fusion age - cleanup merged mark
items.description: Remove temporary merge marker from merged nodes

code.value:
MATCH (m:Node {_new_merged_node: true})
WHERE coalesce(m.graph_id, '__GRAPH_ID__') = '__GRAPH_ID__'
REMOVE m._new_merged_node
RETURN count(m) AS cleaned

items.title: Local complementation age
items.description: AGE-compatible local complementation core case (center phase +/- 1/2 with two Z neighbors via hadamard edges)

code.value:
MATCH (center:Node)-[:Wire {t:2}]-(n1:Node),
      (center)-[:Wire {t:2}]-(n2:Node)
WHERE center.t = 1
  AND n1.t = 1
  AND n2.t = 1
  AND id(n1) < id(n2)
  AND coalesce(center.phase, 0) IN [0.5, -0.5]
WITH center, n1, n2
LIMIT 1
CREATE (n1)-[:Wire {t: 2, graph_id: coalesce(center.graph_id, n1.graph_id, n2.graph_id)}]->(n2)
SET n1.phase = coalesce(n1.phase, 0) - coalesce(center.phase, 0),
    n2.phase = coalesce(n2.phase, 0) - coalesce(center.phase, 0)
DETACH DELETE center
RETURN 1 AS rewritten
